Aurelian builds AI tools that help 911 centers handle more with less, enabling telecommunicators to focus on critical emergencies. The Software Engineer will own product outcomes end-to-end, define priorities, build and ship platform features, and work directly with customers to improve AI call handling, dispatcher tools, analytics, and integrations.

Responsibilities
Own product outcomes, not just features: You won't be handed a spec. You'll talk to customers, identify the highest-leverage problems, figure out what to build, and build it
Be the PM for your area: You'll define the roadmap, make prioritization tradeoffs, and communicate progress across the company
Ship fast and iterate: Build and ship features across our platform — from AI call handling, to dispatcher-facing tools, to analytics and integrations. Get things into customers' hands, learn, and iterate
Work directly with customers: Our users are 9-1-1 dispatchers and PSAP administrators. You'll visit dispatch centers, watch how they use the product, and use that context to drive what you build next

We're hiring Software Engineers who have recently graduated to own product outcomes end-to-end
You've owned products or features end-to-end — not just built what someone else decided
You think in terms of user problems and outcomes, not just technical solutions
You can build what needs building — frontend, backend, or both
You don't need to be the deepest technical expert on the team, but you're a capable, confident engineer
You see a problem, figure out the right thing to build, and drive it to completion
You take responsibility for outcomes, not just your code
You genuinely like understanding how people use software
You're energized by customer conversations, not drained by them
Must have already graduated to be considered
